LightningComponentBundle.description: Choose Voice or Image for POC notes capture. Outputs notesCaptureMethod as Voice or Image for Flow branching.

property.name: titleGrad
property.label: Title (gradient part)
property.description: Second title segment with accent styling.

property.name: hintText
property.label: Hint text
property.default: Select Voice to record audio, or Image to upload a visiting-card photo.

property.name: requireSelectionBeforeNext
property.label: Require selection before Next
property.description: When true, Flow Next stays disabled until Voice or Image is selected.

property.name: notesCaptureMethod
property.label: Notes capture method
property.description: Output: Voice or Image. Map to a Flow Text variable for decision branches.
